# Assessment Engine
> Actuarial intelligence engine and compilation platform transforming client context and empirical evidence into formal AST deliverables.

## Core Directives

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): The Single Source of Truth for all AI Agent operational constraints, non-negotiable quality rules, and change discipline checklists.
- [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md): Operational adapter specific to the Google Gemini CLI workflow.
- [README.md](README.md): Canonical developer onboarding guide and repository overview.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Tier-1 contribution standards, AI-assisted development policy, and testing discipline.

## Architecture & Data Flows

- [docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md): Technical overview of the Ports and Adapters (Hexagonal) architecture, AST compilers, and pipeline stages.
- [docs/architecture/tower-pipeline.md](docs/architecture/tower-pipeline.md): Deep-dive into the single-tower evaluation lifecycle (Phase 1 analysis).
- [docs/architecture/global-commercial-pipelines.md](docs/architecture/global-commercial-pipelines.md): Multi-tower aggregation, executive roadmapping, and commercial rendering pipelines.
- [docs/architecture/mcp-mode.md](docs/architecture/mcp-mode.md): Model Context Protocol (FastMCP) server specifications and execution.

## Contracts & Schemas

- [docs/contracts/artifact-contracts.md](docs/contracts/artifact-contracts.md): Data boundary contracts between pipeline execution modules.
- [docs/contracts/payload-render-boundaries.md](docs/contracts/payload-render-boundaries.md): OpenXML rendering boundaries and visual styles policies.
- [docs/contracts/tower-blueprint-payload.md](docs/contracts/tower-blueprint-payload.md): Technical Pydantic model contracts for single-tower blueprint JSON objects.
- [docs/contracts/tower-annex-payload.md](docs/contracts/tower-annex-payload.md): Pydantic schema contracts for executive annex synthesis JSON objects.

## Operations & DevOps

- [docs/operations/installation.md](docs/operations/installation.md): Setup guide for local virtual environments, Python 3.11, and uv sync.
- [docs/operations/pipeline-execution.md](docs/operations/pipeline-execution.md): Manual and programmatic runbook for executing pipelines.
- [docs/operations/pipeline-controls-runbook.md](docs/operations/pipeline-controls-runbook.md): Telemetry, structured logs, and preflight controls runbook.
- [docs/operations/troubleshooting-working.md](docs/operations/troubleshooting-working.md): Runbook for incident mitigation, working directory cleanup, and dry-run pipeline smoke execution.
- [docs/operations/engineering-quality-gates.md](docs/operations/engineering-quality-gates.md): Linter rules, typing assertions, and CI/CD quality gate enforcement.
- [docs/operations/agentic-development-workflow.md](docs/operations/agentic-development-workflow.md): Strict guidelines for AI-assisted workspace modifications and PR merges.
- [docs/operations/product-owner-orchestrator.md](docs/operations/product-owner-orchestrator.md): Multi-agent product owner workflow orchestration guide.

## Optional

- [docs/strategy/roadmap.md](docs/strategy/roadmap.md): Product and infrastructure roadmap.
- [docs/contracts/tower-annex-design.md](docs/contracts/tower-annex-design.md): Structure, typography, and styling constraints for Microsoft Word Tower Annex documents.
